caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing figure on a rectangular pedestal. The figure has medium brown skin and long dark hair, and is dressed in a knee-length tunic colored teal and red-orange with green trim and fringe. A blue cloth drapes over one shoulder and is held by the left arm. The figure wears a necklace of yellow beads and a headdress adorned with four upright feathers: two predominantly green and two reddish-brown. The left hand holds a bundle or container against the chest, while the right arm is bent, and the hand rests across the stomach. The shoes are beige and simple in design. The statue stands on a stepped base that is beige with brown shading. In the lower right corner, there is text reading “CIGAR STORE INDIAN / HAND CARVED / K.S.C.A. 8 / WATER COLOR BY SELLAND AYRES.” The background is plain and off-white.
title: Cigar Store Indian
